subject: John L. Intoppa Candidate Profile
overview: School Committee candidate John L. Intoppa presented his background, accomplishments on the committee, and priorities for re-election.

items.title: Introduction and Background
items.summary: John L. Intoppa introduced himself as a lifelong Medford resident, higher education professional, and current School Committee member seeking re-election.

items.title: Tenure and Policy Achievements
items.summary: Intoppa reviewed his work since joining the committee in March 2024, highlighting his authorship of the district's clean drinking water policy and support for LGBTQ+ youth, immigrant families, and school accessibility.

items.title: Future Priorities and Re-election Pitch
items.summary: Intoppa outlined his future goals for student civic engagement, arts education, nursing staff advocacy, and expanded after-school programming, while asking for voters' support on November 4th.
